text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Bagging one prize after another...
Turns out she's not a puppy, but a true hunting hound when it comes to claw machines.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Shall I treat you with the utmost tenderness?
Ah, or would you prefer a harsher touch—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Haha, you're rushing it way too much. If you don't have anything specific in mind, how about this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli closed the distance with a smirk,
and whispered into my ear—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Good job keeping your master entertained,
p視聴者ちゃん？
